plugin.note: Tanzanite (blue) form is weak to ranged; magic is near-useless on it. Use ranged here even in an otherwise magic-led trip.

requirements: Access to Zulrah Tanzanite Blue Form's boss encounter and any prerequisite quests, keys, instances, or killcount listed by the linked strategy source.
Use the boss-task Slayer helm or Slayer helmet bonuses when the assignment permits it.
Bring supplies and teleports appropriate to a separate boss trip rather than a normal multi-kill Slayer location.
mechanics: Tanzanite (blue) form is weak to ranged; magic is near-useless on it. Use ranged here even in an otherwise magic-led trip.
Treat this as a boss-specific method: positioning, prayer swaps, phase handling, and death-risk setup should come from the linked source strategy.
Use listed secondary weapons only where their combat style or phase role is relevant.

methods.label: General strategy
methods.summary: Tanzanite (blue) form is weak to ranged; magic is near-useless on it. Use ranged here even in an otherwise magic-led trip.
recommendedFor: Players selecting this boss from the Boss meta-task
steps: Tanzanite (blue) form is weak to ranged; magic is near-useless on it. Use ranged here even in an otherwise magic-led trip.
Use ranged on blue form and keep Protect from Magic active while learning.

methods.label: Blue form ranged
methods.summary: Use ranged against tanzanite form because it is weak to ranged and magic performs poorly.
steps: Switch to ranged gear when Zulrah surfaces in tanzanite form.
Use Twisted bow, Toxic blowpipe, Bow of faerdhinen, or another strong ranged weapon.
Keep Protect from Magic active while learning because blue form uses magic more often than ranged.
Do not rely on ordinary magic damage against this form.
risks: Tanzanite form can use both magic and ranged attacks.
Its ranged hits can punish players camping Protect from Magic.
notes: Magic is near-useless on tanzanite form except for unusual high-end setups already accounted for by the broader strategy.
Twisted bow and Bow of faerdhinen are strong enough to reduce switches in some setups.

methods.label: Hide or tank blue phase
methods.summary: Either tank blue phases with Protect from Magic and food or hide behind pillars during slower learning or magic-only kills.
steps: If using ranged, attack through the blue phase while praying Protect from Magic and eating as needed.
If using magic-only or learning, hide behind a pillar for dangerous tanzanite phases to reduce damage.
Use the downtime while hidden to kill snakelings or heal.
Reposition before the next phase according to the active rotation.
risks: Hiding lowers damage output and can extend the rotation.
Late movement through venom clouds can cost more health than tanking a small amount of damage.
notes: The Wiki suggests hiding from tanzanite phases for slower magic-only diary kills.
Protect from Magic is the default learner prayer because tanzanite uses magic more frequently.

methods.label: Venom and snakelings
methods.summary: Manage venom cloud and snakeling spawns while prioritising Zulrah's high-damage attacks.
steps: Move out of venom cloud 3x3 areas before repeated damage starts.
Run through a cloud only when it prevents more dangerous positioning or Zulrah damage.
Let recoil effects or incidental attacks clear snakelings where possible.
Kill snakelings during hide phases if they are accumulating.
Keep protection prayer focused on Zulrah rather than trying to flick every snakeling.
risks: Snakeling chip damage can combine with blue-form ranged hits.
Venom clouds can block intended rotation movement.
notes: Venom clouds deal venom-type damage but do not envenom the player.
Some snakelings spawn only after Zulrah dives and resurfaces.
